title: Zoo trip · Level 1: The lion
brief: Visit the lion: stop with the robot's middle in the lion's square (the yellow square) and flash the light (on for at least 1 s, standing still). No wheel may touch a green hedge. 60 s. 50 for the lion, up to 40 for speed when it is visited, 10 for no wheel on a hedge. Par: 10 s.

score.run: round(50 * visited + if(visited == 1, 40 * min(1, par / max(time, 0.001)), 0) + if(noGoEntries == 0, 10, 0), 1)

sources.where: G1.3 Left and right, Challenge — Zoo trip: the zoo floor (its 6 x 5 squares from (450, 450), on the panel's grid, 450 mm of plain floor round it: the record names no wall; the gate the blue start box, the card's animal squares yellow for their pictures), the level table (level 1), the scoring paragraph; "How a run is measured" (the G1 run's end, stopped, the flash)
